review.rationale: Methodological contract for Test Card T014. The evidence decision lives in docs/standard. Photometry, membership, ZAHB cut and stellar-model physics are inherited from the published analyses.

question: Does the layer-3 abundance law N = b F/P reproduce an independent globular-cluster ratio R = N_HB/N_RGB(above ZAHB) when a stellar-model error is fixed in advance?

output.quantity: R = N_HB / N_RGB(above ZAHB) and its standardized deviation z
output.domain: 8 in-situ Galactic globular clusters (Gontcharov et al. 2026, HST ACS + Gaia DR3)
output.accuracy: Combined 1-sigma from the observed R (side facing the prediction), the helium input and a stellar-model error of 0.0294 fixed before the comparison.

model.assumptions: Common formation rate through RGB and HB; phase lifetimes from published stellar models (fuel/luminosity); a single He abundance per cluster sample.
model.approximation: Linear fit R_th(Y) = 6.26 Y - 0.12 from stellar models without extra energy sinks.
model.initial_boundary: Old clusters; steady flow through post-main-sequence phases.
model.drive_environment: None beyond the published cluster populations.
model.parameters: No fitting; Y from independent H II regions (primary) and SBBN (sensitivity only).

data_policy.holdout_policy: No holdout. Published R seen in the source abstract before drafting (exposure SEEN_FULL), declared in Test Card T014. The star counts are independent of the T002 counts (different telescopes, membership and ZAHB cut), but no formal ancestry record is attached, so independent_validation is not claimed.

system_partition.boundary: Published star counts in 8 in-situ globular clusters, observed photometrically; the comparison uses the published mean R and model fit, not raw photometry.

systems.state: Joint description of a cluster population, not an extra state

state_accounting.rule: Each star is counted once, in the phase it occupies.

systems.state: Stars on the upper red giant branch (H-shell burning)
Stars on the horizontal branch (core He burning)
HST ACS and Gaia DR3 catalogues and published counts

state_accounting.rule: Observer record only; carries no stellar energy.

couplings.map: Each star leaves the RGB tip and enters the HB (helium flash); common flow rate b
Starlight with reddening and distance handled upstream
Passive photometry exerts no admitted backaction
Passive photometry exerts no admitted backaction

observables.backaction_scope_reason: Both counted owners are assessed; the cluster aggregate is a nonadditive view.
observables.quantity: Constant N_HB/N_RGB(above ZAHB) for 8 in-situ clusters
observables.readout_map: Constant R for in-situ clusters from Gontcharov et al. 2026; transcribed only

observation.source_state: Stellar populations as modelled by the published analyses.
observation.generated_trace: Starlight; not a UET trace variable.
observation.carrier: Photons; not identified with any UET field.
observation.readout: Published mean R and stellar-model fit.
observation.frame: Cluster rest frame of the published analysis
observation.time_convention: Stellar-evolution time of the published models

components.reason: Phase populations and lifetimes as registered from published counts and stellar models.
No external drive in the comparison.
Applied upstream in the published star counts and stellar models (Gontcharov et al. 2026; Ayala et al. 2014); not recomputed here.

error_budget.approximation: Linear R_th(Y) fit; validity range declared by the source.
error_budget.measurement: Observed R 1-sigma (side facing the prediction) and helium 1-sigma, in quadrature.
error_budget.systematic: Stellar-model error 0.0294 from Cassisi et al. 2003 ranges (12C(alpha,gamma), breathing-pulse suppression), fixed in the card; journal cross-check not done.
error_budget.omissions: Non-steady HB population after disk crossings (reported by the source), He-enhanced subpopulations and extra energy sinks are not modelled.
error_budget.dependence: Counts (HST ACS + Gaia) are independent of the Salaris et al. 2004 counts behind T002; the R_th fit and helium input are shared with T002.
error_budget.acceptance: Outcome categories fixed in Test Card T014 (z <= 2 PASS, 2 < z <= 3 INCONCLUSIVE, z > 3 FAIL).

claim_boundary: Methodological coverage of the T014 comparison only. The evidence level is set in docs/standard. The comparison cannot distinguish UET layer 3 from the standard fuel-consumption reasoning it reproduces.
next_action: Cross-check transcribed values against the journal version; model the non-steady HB population if a quantitative estimate is published.
